//: Committed floor for scripts/check-css-scale.mjs. Every number here is debt to pay down. Lower it with `node scripts/check-css-scale.mjs --update-budget` after a cleanup; raising one is a hand edit that needs a written reason in the commit, the same rule as BUDGET in report-a11y.mjs.
//font-size: 1118 -> 210 on 2026-09-01, when the --text-* scale went rem and 14 agents swept every bare literal onto it. What is left is NOT bare literals: it is ~200 hand-rolled clamp() type curves whose range no fluid role token covers, plus six decorative sizes above the scale's 64px ceiling (74, 88, 90, 128, 220, 340). Closing the rest means a scale of fluid steps, which does not exist yet. Note the metric widened at the same time: rem font-sizes now count too, because rem stopped being a neutral unit the moment the scale became rem.
//section-padding: New category, born at ZERO. 564 vertical section paddings across 33 arbitrary values were snapped onto the --section-y-* 8px grid on 2026-09-01. Keep it at zero.
//non-flipping-text: New category, born at ZERO on 2026-09-03 after 187 labels were found unreadable in dark mode: 100 `color: var(--plum)` (plum never flips, so the type stayed near-black on the dark page: 1.24:1 at worst), 87 `color: var(--cream)` (cream flips the WRONG way for type, to near-black, so cream labels on a locked-dark plum or coral fill vanished), plus 21 `rgba(var(--plum-rgb), N)` faint labels and 3 color-mix operands. Nothing was watching: this gate gated EDGES built on --plum-rgb and nothing else. The 12 genuine exceptions, type on a ground that is light in both themes, carry the `css-scale-allow: non-flipping-text` marker rather than a budget, so a real regression cannot hide behind them. Keep it at zero. Still ungated and still real debt: ~29 plum fill/stroke values on SVG illustrations, 6 text-decoration-color underlines and 2 scrollbar-color thumbs.
//plum-border: New category, floored at ONE rather than zero, deliberately. The single survivor is AdminMembersPage.module.css .legendInbound, a trust-network legend KEY whose border-top IS the coloured line, drawn to match .previewEdge / .graphEdge (both `stroke: rgba(var(--plum-rgb), ...)`). Flipping the key to cream in dark mode while the edge it labels stays plum would break the legend, and its siblings .legendMutual / .legendOutbound use --jade-rgb / --accent-rgb, neither of which flips either. The real defect there is that the graph strokes do not flip; that is an SVG stroke, not a border, and out of this gate's scope. If those strokes are ever fixed, drop this floor to 0.
